description: Vicmap Transport - Road and Paper Road Line is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. This layer is a superset of the Vicmap TRROAD dataset; the latter dataset that is part of Vicmap Transport. It is an extensive digital road network - line features delineating state wide road network. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are Structure, Transportation. It offers 7 resource(s) in DWG, DXF, EXTENDED TAB, GDB, MIF. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
